balls.text: he was aiming for the blimp! stays at the crease and gets all his power behind it and the distance as well, goes to the sightscreen
power! White stays at the crease and butchers it over wide long-off, seemed like a mishit but the ball landed over the second tier
Kohli tries to go downtown but he doesn't get the timing right and finds long-on

Image of the day for sure! Kohli backs away and Harris follows him by aiming at the body, Kohli somehow tries to pull it uncomfortably to fine leg, he loses balance and nearly does an "Inzamam", he nearly falls on the stumps but avoids contact
scoops it over extra cover, checks his shot
slashed and a thick edge flies past the keeper, Marsh apologies to Gilly
steps forward and tries to launch it over deep extra cover but he mishits it down to deep point instead, Harris forward and takes a fine tumbling catch falling forward
knocks it down to deep square leg
he comes forward and swats it high in the air over the on side, the ball drops short of deep midwicket, that's his fifty!
a dot ball, an anomaly! Lands just outside off and beats him for pace and bounce
bowls length and he gets punished, on middle and off and he scoops it over the bowler's head
forces it down to long-on
RP pitches it up on middle and off but Kohli makes room and scoops it high over long-off, just clears the rope
RP comes round the wicket and Kohli makes room to swing that over the on side but he swishes at thin air
tries a short arm pull  but the ball is picked up at midwicket
this time he goes to the off side, makes room and bashes it hard and beats sweeper cover
short on the body and pulled away with such force along the turf that deep midwicket had no time to react
makes too much room and he pushes a low full toss to extra cover, the fielder gets a hand to it
take that! Picks the ball on a good length and stays at the crease and clubs it hard and high over deep midwicket
this time he gets beside the line and slams it hard past backward point, sweeper cover cannot cut it off
pitched up outside off and he scoops it high over extra cover this time, the crowd's loving this
hits the roof! Stays at the crease, makes room and cracks it over the bowler's head, the ball hits the roof and lands back on the turf, great shot
stays back and pulls hard along the turf but Kallis is happy with the single
opens the face and this time  he angles it straight to the third man fielder
cheeky but great shot, Kallis knows there's no slip so he opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man, doesn't try to play it too hard
angles it on middle and leg and tucked to the on side
swings hard but only swishes at thin air, Kohli plays that too early
cramps him for room but he gets forward and taps it to the off side and takes off
punches it down to cover point
short and he pulls hard to deep midwicket
the bouncer costs five, down the leg side and Kohli shapes to hook but the ball beats the keeper

deft touch! Kallis rides the bounce which is angled towards his body, he bends his back slightly and upper cuts it over the keeper,the umpire thinks it;s six but RP signals a four, the umpire checks upstairs
chops it to the off side and they set off quickly, Kohli makes it before the direct hit again but the ball ricochets to the on side and they take another run
short and wide outside off and he slams it down to sweeper cover
taps it to the of side and sets off quickly, Kohli reaches just before the direct hit at the bowler's end
tucks it off his pads to the on side
loses his line and sprays it down the leg side
nips it back in and Kallis can only defend it back to the bowler
fails to control the swing and he slides it down the leg side
stays back and swats it down to long-on
Kohli chips down the track but he;s beaten again, Marsh gets good bounce outside off
comes forward and chips it wide of square leg
tucks it wide of midwicket
pulls hard to long-on
Deccan caught napping, Kallis pushes it towards Rohit at point and takes off for a quick single, Rohit has a shy at the bowler's end but Ojha's not behind the throw, nobody backing up
gets forward and pushes it to the off side
makes room and cuts hard to deep point
steps forward and makes room to crash that through the off side but he's beaten for bounce outside off
keeps it nice and straight, Kohli can only push it back to the bowler
punchy drive through the off side and fielded by sweeper cover
angling down the leg side, Kallis is on one leg as he tries to pull but he ends up gloving it down to fine leg
nice line and length just outside off, beats  Kallis on the punched drive
full on middle and leg and pushed down the ground to long-on
tossed up on middle and leg, he gets forward and defends to the on side
stays back and cuts to sweeper cover, a fumble by Rao allows a second run
stays back and tucks it to the on side
opens the face and steers it to the off side
gets well forward and defedns

delayed decision from Harper but a straightforward one, lands on a length on the off stump and goes through straight, Taylor is rooted to the backfoot, the ball skids and hits his pads in front of middle, he stayed on the backfoot and that led to his undoing
pitched up outside off and he reaches forward and scoops it just over extra cover, beats the fielder in the deep
squirted just wide of Suman at backward point
another poor shot, Uthappa goes for a wild slash to a wide delivery outside off, targets the on side, plays too early and gets an edge to Gilchrist who's up to the stumps
Uthappa targets the on side again but he ends up getting a thick inside edge to his pads
fullish in length and worked wide of midwicket
keeps it nice and tight on the off stump and he tucks it across the line to deep square leg
goes for a big slog but he clubs it along the turf to deep square leg
gets forward and tucks it to the on side
poor shot and soft dismissal, he chips down the track to target the on side, Ojha cleverly drops the length shorter and gets it to turn a bit, Dravid gets a tame top edge to Rohit at point
slow through the air, he stays back and pushes it to mid-on
stays back and cuts to cover
pushes it hard down to midwicket
makes room to cut but the ball beats him outside off
steers it to the off side for a single, good over so far
loss in concentration there, Dravid tries to mow it somewhere over the on side but swings too early, the ball beats him outside off
walks down the pitch but the ball gets high on him so he can only fend it to the on side
angles it on middle and he clips it down to midwicket
slower ball, he opens the face and angles it down to gully
tucks it down to midwicket
towards the pads and clipped to fine leg
lovely shot, lands it on middle and there's no turn, he makes room, rocks back and cuts hard between backward point and cover
flighted on middle and leg, he stays back and cuts to the off side
gets a half  stride forward and defends
stays back and pulls hard along the ground to deep midwicket
tucked off the pads to the on side
bouncer and Dravid's beaten for pace and bounce as he tries to pull
Dropped Tough one, Dravid tries to crash that straight down the ground but RP holds out his left hand and deflects it away, had no time to react
goes for the pull and misses
good comeback, he holds the length back and the ball squares up Dravid outside off
that's a cracker! Friendly overpitched ball outside off, he leans forward, gets under the bounce and scoops it long and high over long-off
short and wide outside off and he stands tall,bends backward and punches hard between backward point and cover
big slash, gets forward and aims to bash that over cover but he gets a thick outside edge over first slip who was wide, one bounce and four
down the leg side and Kallis tries a one-legged pull but misses
gets forward and squirts it just wide of mid-off
better line and length on the off stump, stays back and pushes it to the off side
welcome to India Mitch! Rank half volley outside off moving away, Dravid plays a stylish square drive past cover and backward point
gets beside the line and chops it to point
plays a short arm pull from the off stump, midwicket chases and they could have run three
this one lands short of a length and hits him high on the pad, half hearted appeal, good bowling
RP mistook first slip for the batsman, that's how wide that was
this one nips back in and hits him on the thigh, Dravid stares at the pitch
very unconvincing shot, he went forward to a wide delivery outside off and sort of scooped it over cover, he checked his shot
full and he pushes it just wide of mid-off and takes a single
Dravid is completely squared up for bounce and movement outside off, wafts at it, Harris is getting it to move both ways
gets across and defends it with soft hands
drops his bat and steers it away to short third man
middle stump is down! The ball just nips back in off the seam, Pandey is too slow in getting behind the line but the ball skids through and hits the top of middle stump, may have been an inside edge
he has the width outside off to cut but Pandey opts to let it go to the keeper
tucks him up a bit and he clips it down to midwicket
good delivery, lands just a shade outside off and the away movement just beats the bat
too full and wide outside off, he tries to jam it out
stays behind the line and pushes it to mid-on
take cover! Comes down the pitch, picks the ball on a length and slams it over deep extra cover, fell rows back
good shot, got a little high on him but he adjusted well, bends his back backwards and punches wide of backward point and cover
comes down the pitch to bash that but makes contact off the bottom edge
slides down the leg side, fails to control the seam
good bounce and carry, squared up Pandey outside off
angles it just wide of gully who was earlier at second slip, third man comes across and stops it
great stop by Suman at backward point, slides to his right and saves it one-handed, saves a four there
gets behind the line and defends to the off side
too wide down the leg side, good take by Gilly
gets a thick outside edge, more like a leading edge, great delivery shaping away from the right hander, flies past second slip
too wide outside off and Pandey has a slash at it
seam movement from Harris away from the right-hander, beats Pandey's prod
game ovaaah! Pitched on middle and off and he makes room and swings it over mid-on, the ball just drops short of the rope
whoa! Vinay bowls a full toss and Symonds backs away and bashes it to the second tier at wide long-on!
squirts a yorker down to short cover
comes over the wicket to Suman, another yorker squeezed down the ground
comes round the wicket and Symonds tucks it to midwicket
will this be the most important hit for Deccan? Kallis errs by pitching it up and Symonds gets under the bounce and scoops it over long-off, clean hit!
flayed to long-off and Symonds wanted the second but Suman was happy with the single
slower ball on a yorker length and Suman can only squirt it back to the bowler, great ball
yorker outside off and squeezed out to cover
fierly yorker on the stumps and he manages to tuck it to short fine leg, no matter how hard he tries Steyn can't seem to hit the stumps
slower ball, he chips it down the ground and the ball drops short of long-on
he's on a roll! Steyn aims for the yorker length but it's a friendly full toss which Suman slices wide if backward point
fires it on a yorker length outside off and he jams it out to backward point
full on the pads and squirted down to long-on
full on the pads and clipped to the on side
shot! Praveen's nightmare over here, he switches to a fuller length but gets scooped high over the sight screen
game on! Symonds picks another slower ball early and bashes it over deep midwicket, Praveen makes the mistake of dropping it short
slower ball but too wide outside off, he's not chasing that
lucky boundary for Symonds, he backs away to a shorter delivery and gets a thick edge which just flies over Uthappa who leaps up
backs away and chips a low full toss to deep extra cover
mistimes it to midwicket
chips a low full toss to long-on
he packs a punch! Gets his front foot forward to a length delivery and shovels it over deep midwicket
stays at the crease and chips it in the air down to deep midwicket
slower  ball and he smacks it to deep cover and White fumbles
driven to deep extra cover
swings it down to deep midwicket
Kumble dives full length to his right and intercepts it, good fielding
that's his fifty! Picks it on a good length and swings it high over deep midwicket, clean hit
muscles it down to long-on
down the leg side and Symonds gently paddles it down to fine leg, takes it on the full
moves right across his stumps and tucks it to the on side
pace like fire! He fires it on a yorker length and Symonds makes some room and slices it on the full down to third man,the fielder slides but can't cut it off
he gives him some width this time and he slashes hard, the outside edge flies to third man
now Symonds makes a bit of room to slam it over extra cover but he too is beaten for pace
scooped towards mid-off but the ball just drops short of Vinay
full and quick outside off and beats him, too quick for Suman
full on middle and leg and chipped away to long-on
Suman tries to hoick him away without moving his feet, chops it onto his body
the slower ball and he clips him down to square leg
drops it a bit shorter and he places it down to point
clips it down to short midwicket for a single
full and driven hard down the ground but Vinay does really well at mid-off to cut it off
cuts hard down to third man
Rohit's frustrated with himself! he ends up chipping it straight to Steyn at mid-off who barely moved, soft dismissal
pinches a single to midwicket
pushes it to the off side for a single
drops it short and he rides the bounce and pulls hard and firm to deep midwicket, the placement was perfect
tucks it to the on side and they scrape through, Uthappa has a shy at the batsman's end
gets a half stride forward and defends
the old fox has done it again! Gilchrist chips down the track and Kumble drops it short and bowls the googly, he's beaten and an easy stumping by Uthappa
tossed up on the leg side and he sweeps it down to deep square leg
drops it on a good length, picks the length early and hoicks it over deep midwicket
full on the off stump and he drives to deep cover
stand and deliver! Stylish stuff, stays at the crease to a pitched up delivery and elegantly scoops it down to long-on, he didnt move an inch after playing that
short down the leg side and Gilchrist tries to pull but he's beaten for pace
fires it on the stumps and he just manages to clip it to the on side
lands it wide outside off and Suman can't chase that
fiery delivery on the middle stump and Gilchrist makes a hint of room and chops it down to backward point
full outside off and squirted to the off side, takes a quick single and the throw is wide at the bowler's end
pushed to long-on
another inside edge onto the body
mistimes it to deep square leg
backs away to the on side but ends up clipping it onto his pads
down the leg side
streaky! He comes down the pitch and tries to mow it over the on side, gets an inside edge past the stumps and down to fine leg
makes room and lofts over extra cover, Kohli runs across and cuts it off
Kallis sees the funny side to it! He digs it in short on the body and Gilly sways back and runs it down to third man, deft touch, Kallis is an expert on that shot
over the second tier! Can we have the ball back please? Stays at the crease and lofts it high over wide long-on, pitched up and goodbye!
cuts hard straight to point
in the slot for Gilchrist, he stays at the crease and slams it down the ground, one bounce and four and long-off gave up as soon as the ball left the bat
the ball climbs on him and he gets his bat high and fends it off
lands outside off and he shoulders arms
tries to go over the top and ends up chipping it down to third man, Praveen watches the spin at the right time and stops it first bounce
clips it down to deep midwicket
backs away and slaps it over the on side
he slices it just wide of Kohli at backward point, would have been a great diving catch
backs away and slaps it over extra cover, the sweeper cuts it off
hits a good length, Suman clips across the line towards long leg and Taylor slides across from deep square leg but can't cut it off
tucks him up for room and he clips it to midwicket, good over from Kallis
clips it down to backward square leg
stays back and tucks it back to the bowler
slices him in half! Cuts back in and the ball just sails over the middle stump
tucks him up for room and he chops it down just wide of second slip
goes for the short arm pull and the ball drops short of mid-on
great cut! Stays at the crease and slices it hard and fast past backward point
swings hard and he chips the ball over extra cover, more like a slice
close call for a lbw! Lands just outside and hits his pads in front of the stumps
thick leading edge which drops short of third man
big appeal for a caught behind! Did that clip something? Rip snorter of a delivery on the body and there was a sound, Harper wasn't sure, may have been a great decision
sloppy from Steyn, he directs it so wide outside off that no batsman could have chased it
154 kph and on the stumps, Sumna just manages to get behind the line and tap it down to mid-off for a quick single
pacy delivery on the body and he chips it softly to the on side, the ball drops at short midwicket
in the length to drive hard off the front foot but he mistimes it to mid-off
that scorched to the boundary in a couple of seconds, gets a fraction of width and bangs it along the turf past backward point, third man had no time to react
Gilchrist tries to chase that one but it was too wide outside off
Suman shoulders arms this time
beats him outside off again, good away movement
left the bat well, Suman leans forward and chips a pitched up delivery over mid-on, good elevation and timing on that one
nice angle to the right-hander and he prods forward and he's beaten
leaves him outside off

good catch! Mishra gets a short one on the body and tries to upper cut it to third man like Kallis did, the ball hits his gloves and dips towards Uthappa's right, in front of slip, takes it one handed inches off the ground
Dropped Tough one, tries to scoop it over Kumble but the bowler leaps up and deflects it towards White at mid-off
steps down the track and this time he gets the elevation over mid-off, nice shot
Mishra tries to loft over mid-off but the ball just lands short of Vinay, good fielding anyhow
hits his pads maybe just down the leg side, loud appeal
the ball skids through and tucks him up, he chops it down the pitch
gets forward to a full ball and drives down to mid-off
comes dow n the track to loft him down the ground but Praveen holds the length back, the ball sails over the stumps, top ball
angles away from the right hander and he' beaten for movement
good shot! Gets beside the line, rides the bounce and cuts past backward point, nice timing
steers it to Kohli at backward point and Gilchrist tells his partner to wait
bowls it dead straight, stays behind the line and pushes it to the on side
lands it on middle and off and tucked softly to the on side
